subject: Would you test a browser-based 3D OMFS review workflow?
body:
Hi Dr. Tiwana,

I'm Emmanuel, building MedViz, a browser-based 3D case review workflow for maxillofacial mesh review.

I reached out because your OUHSC faculty profile highlights leadership across facial trauma, orthognathic surgery, and cleft/craniofacial work, which made you seem like a strong fit for blunt feedback on whether this type of review workflow is genuinely useful.

The current version supports in-browser 3D review, measurements, annotations, slicing, orientation and unit confirmation, and exportable review reports.

If you're open to it, here is the live app: https://medviz-web-editor.vercel.app/

I'm looking for a few surgeons who can try it on a de-identified case or short demo and tell me what feels useful, what feels risky, and what would not survive real clinical use.

Thanks,
Emmanuel
